notes.title: Patch 32.06
notes.notes:
Catch Me! releases it's next patch and this time we're adding some ways to express yourself.

[h1]Emotes 2.0[/h1]
Have you ever wondered what it looks like when Bob loses again or Milo celebrates after a successful score? With the new character-based emotes, you can now cheer on your fellow players and make your opponents go berserk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/ebee8f588322cb6bcd2ff05277250ea89cedbcd8.png[/img]

[h1]Time for improvements[/h1]
We worked  on the progression and xp system. In addition to this, there were improvements in some of the supporting languages. The whole thing is rounded off with a new loading screen, which you will certainly see a time or two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/3cb9342892dbe0c145e807687bdbdbc77e9c4508.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Bug where game crashes at max Level
[*]Fixed Issues with ladders
[*]Visual button and cable issues fixed
[*]A few minor bugs were erased
[/list]

notes.title: Catch Me Halloween Patch 31.0.3
notes.notes:
Catch Me! releases it's second major patch and this time we're starting of the spooky season. 

[h2]New Map: Romania[/h2]
What's that? You can teleport from one floor to another? Could you use that to escape from your scary chasers?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/ae7bd805e1dd2b0676b2dd11db9607d98d4c668d.png[/img]

[h2]New Skins[/h2]
Spook around the world as a wicked witch, a frightening Jack o' Lantern or strike fear into your friends as Killer Mike. 
The 3 new scary skins are now available in Catch Me!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/1d695841f8f6133e2a31bc38b3a1a4aef660110c.png[/img]

[h2]New Catch Animation[/h2]
Make a shiver run up your friends spine everytime you catch them with the new ghosts catch animation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/730ef43e0ba95a1ddb37708d9cb0ba33a5d3f4ea.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- bug fixes with environment interactables
- fixes of missing and fault localizations
- visual hud fixes
- several keybinding fixes involving the emote tab

Since the early access release, we've noticed or been made aware of some bugs. We fixed a whole bunch of them.
If you notice any other bugs, don't hesitate to write them to us on our Discord server.

notes.title: Patch 30.0.9
notes.notes:
The first major Catch Me! patch is here and with it a new map, new skins and a completely new addition:  animated emotes!  


[h2]New Map: India [/h2]
Chase your friends through the crowded country of India.  
Can you handle the incredibly busy Indian traffic? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/38b594c225f22b4ba3a62e0bea550d600e137605.jpg[/img]

[h2]Emotes[/h2]  
Express yourself through emotes to communicate with other players.  
Oh and don't forget: take the emotes with a grain of salt ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/a3c631cbdcfd6fbf2e89b284ab8e34c2b8f07ba5.png[/img]

[h2]3 new Skins  [/h2]
A new batch of skins has arrived. 
Run around the world as a prideful sumo wrestler. Enjoy winning the game as Harley Kim. Or magically fly through the level as a beautiful fairy. The choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/c283a19ba6ea36dc16cf0a24829d7bda69f43b10.png[/img]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Catch Me! now has 20 achievements that you can unlock by completing the challenges.

[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]	 
[list]
[*] Several animation fixes 
[*] Lobby fixes with quick match 
[*] Network stability 
[*] UI-Fixes (character selection, HUD fixes) 
[/list]

Since the early access release, we've noticed or been made aware of some bugs. We fixed a whole bunch of them. 
If you notice any other bugs, don't hesitate to write them to us on our Discord server.

notes.title: Celebrating our Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Are you ready for the craziest game of tag ever? 

We're are happy to announce that "Catch Me!" enters it's early access TODAY! 
Tag along around the world in this competetive 4-player game! 

Starting NOW you can get your version of "Catch Me!"

Enjoy new content like new characters, maps and features EVERY MONTH! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291956/d4efd2b6d47b9b05c942d623e24dc75c904ce73f.png[/img]

If you have fun please give a positive review. It helps out a lot! Thanks. <3

We hope you enjoy the game and maybe you'll catch us in game.
